job.title: Head of Enterprise Sales - Common Room
job.description:
VP of Enterprise SalesWhat You Can Expect

What you can expect

As Head of Enterprise Sales at Zoom Revenue Accelerator, you will own the enterprise revenue number end to end, from pipeline strategy and forecasting to team development and executive-level customer relationships. You will build and lead a high-performing team of enterprise AEs and front-line managers, with a clear focus on winning new logos and expanding strategic accounts across marketing, sales, and RevOps buyers. Day to day, you will run a disciplined forecast cadence, personally engage on complex multi-stakeholder deals, and coach your team to consistently perform at their best. Prior experience leading enterprise sales teams in B2B SaaS, including managing managers, is required for this role. This position involves up to 25% travel for customer meetings and team engagements, and reports directly to the Chief Revenue Officer.


About the Team

The Zoom Revenue Accelerator team builds AI-powered intelligence into the selling experience, consolidating buyer signals into a single view so revenue teams can identify the right targets, craft relevant messages, and act at the right moment. Backed by over $50M in funding and now fully integrated into Zoom, the team operates at the intersection of AI and enterprise go-to-market, helping customers drive measurable pipeline and growth.


Responsibilities

  • Build and develop a high-performing team of enterprise AEs and front-line managers, including setting talent standards, running regular deal and call reviews, and creating structured onboarding and career paths that accelerate ramp time.
  • Define, document, and enforce a repeatable enterprise sales process using a proven methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, owning forecast accuracy and pipeline discipline across the team.
  • Lead and personally engage on complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, navigating long sales cycles, procurement, legal, and security reviews to close six- and seven-figure contracts.
  • Own enterprise new-logo and expansion bookings targets, partnering with Finance and RevOps to build territory, account, and capacity plans, set quotas, and design compensation structures.
  • Partner with Marketing, SDR and BDR teams, Customer Success, and RevOps on pipeline generation, account-based motions, and land-and-expand strategies that protect and grow net revenue retention.
  • Report on team performance, market dynamics, and product feedback to executive leadership and the board using clear, data-backed insights that influence roadmap, packaging, and pricing.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience in martech or revtech (e.g., CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, intent data, ABM, or revenue intelligence), selling to marketing, sales, and RevOps buyers.
  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS sales overall, including 5+ years leading enterprise sales teams with managers-of-managers experience and a demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding team targets year over year.
  • Deep command of enterprise sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or equivalent), with fluency in forecasting, pipeline management, and running complex six- and seven-figure deals.
  • Proven coaching track record: experience developing reps into top performers and promoting people into leadership, with the ability to articulate how it was done.
  • Strong hiring instincts and team-building experience, including building enterprise AE teams from the ground up across multiple stages of company scale.
  • Executive presence with C-suite buyers (CMO, CRO, CEO) and a data-driven operating style, including comfort with CRM hygiene, dashboards, and using metrics to diagnose and fix performance gaps.
  • Cross-functional partnership mindset, with experience working closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps and a track record of shared accountability and influence without authority.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$200,700.00

Maximum:

$447,900.00



In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure;  there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

job.description:
What you can expect

The Channel Account Manager enhances sales revenue by building relationships with partners in Saudi Arabia They collaborate with partners on marketing plans, training, and needs. They drive growth through channel programs and align with objectives while maintaining customer satisfaction.


About the Team

The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. With a focus on delivering cutting-edge communication solutions for clients across all sectors, the team passionately engages with clients worldwide. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.
 

What we’re looking for

  • Have 2+ years experience in managing partnerships in Unified Communications/ Cloud /Telephony space.
  • Be able to develop and execute sales strategies for Partner programs & sales enablement
  • Experience with SaaS Resellers in Saudi Arabia; fluent Arabic speaker required
  • Have a deep understanding of the Partner ecosystem
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills to effectively collaborate with partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Be proficient in analyzing sales data and market trends to identify opportunities for growth with Channel partners
  • Have collaborated with the Alliances that drive the Zoom ecosystem. i.e Poly, Dten, NEAT, Oracle, Ribbon, Jabra, Verint.




ما يُمكن توقعه
يُعزز مدير حسابات القنوات إيرادات المبيعات من خلال بناء علاقات متينة مع الشركاء في المملكة العربية السعودية. ويتعاون مع الشركاء في وضع خطط التسويق والتدريب وتلبية احتياجاتهم. كما يُساهم في دفع عجلة النمو من خلال برامج القنوات، ويتوافق مع الأهداف مع الحفاظ على رضا العملاء.


نبذة عن الفريق
يُمثل فريق مبيعات Zoom قوة دافعة لنجاح الشركة. ويركز الفريق على تقديم حلول اتصالات متطورة للعملاء في جميع القطاعات، ويتفاعل بحماس مع العملاء حول العالم. ومن خلال الشراكات الاستراتيجية والنهج الذي يضع العميل في صميم اهتمامه، يلعب الفريق دورًا محوريًا في توسيع نطاق حضور Zoom العالمي، وضمان استفادة الشركات من الإمكانات الكاملة للتعاون الافتراضي.


ما نبحث عنه

  • امتلاك خبرة من 5 إلى 7 سنوات في إدارة الشراكات في مجال الاتصالات الموحدة / الحوسبة السحابية / الهاتف.
  • القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات لبرامج الشركاء وتمكين المبيعات
  • خبرة في التعامل مع موزعي البرامج كخدمة (SaaS) في المملكة العربية السعودية، مع اشتراط إتقان اللغة العربية تحدثاً وكتابة.
  • امتلاك فهم عميق لنظام الشركاء البيئي
  • امتلاك مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة للتعاون بفعالية مع الشركاء وأصحاب المصلحة الداخليين.
  • الكفاءة في تحليل بيانات المبيعات واتجاهات السوق لتحديد فرص النمو مع شركاء القنوات
  • التعاون مع التحالفات التي تدفع نظام Zoom البيئي، مثل Poly و Dten و NEAT و Oracle و Ribbon و Jabra و Verint.

job.title: Software Engineer, Data Foundations
job.description:
What you can expect

You will architect our data platform's foundation from ingestion to semantic layer. You'll partner with business and AI teams to design production-grade, self-service data systems. Your work directly enables reliable analytics at scale and deterministic LLM querying

About the Team

We build the core data infrastructure powering analytics and AI across the organization. Our team operates at the intersection of systems engineering, domain modeling, and client delivery. We prioritize long-term technical health alongside rapid iteration.

Responsibilities

  • Designing and building scalable, fault-tolerant data pipelines that transform raw source data into trusted, well-documented datasets across batch and streaming patterns.

  • Owning data quality and observability end-to-end — implementing monitoring, alerting, testing, and documentation for all pipelines and models.

  • Building and evolving the semantic and metric layer, establishing context and guardrails that let both human analysts and AI agents query data reliably.

  • Architecting well-modeled datasets applying dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or One Big Table principles with sound grain definition and key strategy.

  • Engineering enterprise-scale data solutions leveraging Generative AI frameworks (Codex, Claude Code, Snowflake Cortex) to accelerate development and intelligent analytics.

What we’re looking for

  • Have 6+ years of software engineering experience (or equivalent practical experience) with substantial focus on data architecture or system design.

  • Demonstrate proven ability to architect or design complex data models (grain selection, key strategy, schema design) and scale data platforms in multi-tenant environments.

  • Show fluency in Python, Java, or Scala with solid software engineering fundamentals.

  • Possess deep expertise in data modeling paradigms: dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or One Big Table.

  • Partner directly with business teams, product leaders, or external clients to translate ambiguous requirements into technical solutions.

  • Have experience with batch and streaming pipeline architectures including multi-region replication

job.title: Premier Support Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect


Lead a team of Technical Account Managers at the center of Zoom's most strategic enterprise relationships, directly shaping customer outcomes and the long-term health of the Premier Support portfolio. Day to day, you will develop your team, define performance goals, and serve as an executive escalation point for complex customer situations, working closely with Customer Success, Service Engineering, and Sales. This is a role for someone who leads with data, builds accountability with genuine care, and is committed to developing people alongside delivering results. You will report to senior leadership within the Global Premier Support organization. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team


The Premier Support team delivers high-touch technical account management for Zoom's most strategic enterprise customers, helping them realize the full value of Zoom Workplace. Working at the intersection of technical expertise and relationship management, the team partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to resolve complex challenges and drive proactive outcomes. As a core part of Zoom's customer experience strategy, the team plays a meaningful role in retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the Premier portfolio.


Responsibilities


  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Account Managers, building the skills and competencies needed to deliver outstanding Premier Support experiences.
  • Recruit, onboard, and grow talent within the TAM organization, ensuring all business processes and quality standards are upheld.
  • Define and drive team KPIs, quarterly goals, and strategic initiatives aligned to the broader Premier Services program.
  • Analyze team performance data and process metrics to proactively identify risk factors, growth opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement.
  • Own executive-level escalation for complex customer situations, partnering with Customer Success Managers, Escalations, and Service Engineering to drive timely resolution.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to strengthen customer relationships and support retention and growth across the Premier portfolio.
  • Identify underperformance within the team and manage structured improvement plans with appropriate senior support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to deliver data-driven decisions that strengthen team processes and the Premier Services program.

What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams in a customer-facing organization, with a track record of developing high-performing talent.
  • 5+ years of experience in the SaaS industry and/or Unified Communications space, with deep familiarity with enterprise collaboration environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence executive-level stakeholders, including delivering compelling presentations and driving strategic alignment.
  • Proven track record of executing strategy at operational and organizational scale, using data and performance metrics to inform decisions.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and solutions to deliver measurable improvements in team efficiency and service delivery.
  • Familiarity with Unified Communications technologies such as Zoom Workplace, Cisco, Microsoft, or equivalent platforms; knowledge of IP telephony, SIP, or API/SDK integration is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

job.title: Senior AI Sales Specialist - ZoomMate & Agentic Search
job.description:
What You Can Expect

Zoom’s AI platform is at an inflection point, and this role places you at the center of that shift. As a Senior AI Sales Specialist, you will serve as the dedicated AI subject-matter expert for Zoom’s enterprise sales organization, partnering directly with Account Executives to land and expand Zoommate and Agentic Search across the install base and net-new logos. Day to day, you will translate Zoom’s “Conversation to Completion” vision into concrete business outcomes for C-level buyers, IT decision makers, and line-of-business stakeholders in Zoom’s most strategic customer engagements. This role requires prior experience in an overlay or specialist sales motion and the ability to lead C-suite conversations and executive briefing sessions independently. You will report into Zoom’s AI Sales leadership.


About the Team

Our AI Sales team accelerates AI adoption across Zoom’s enterprise customer base, working at the intersection of sales, product, and customers to design and deploy AI workflows that create measurable business outcomes. We serve as proof of concept for Zoom’s AI platform in the field, helping enterprise customers understand and realize the full value of Zoommate and Agentic Search. As a high-impact, close-knit team, we work directly with Zoom’s most strategic accounts and maintain a direct line to Product and Engineering research.


Responsibilities

  • Own the AI narrative for strategic enterprise engagements, translating Zoommate’s platform capabilities into business outcomes for C-level buyers, IT leaders, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Partner with UpMarket and Enterprise AEs to identify AI opportunities, run discovery sessions, lead technical demonstrations, and build joint account plans that position Zoommate as a full-platform investment.
  • Represent Zoom’s AI strategy at Executive Briefing Centers and industry events, leading sessions for Zoom’s most strategic customers.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Engineers and Deployed Engineers to ensure POC success, reducing buyer risk and accelerating deal velocity.
  • Build and distribute repeatable sales enablement assets, including talk tracks, competitive battle cards, and ROI frameworks, to elevate field performance across AI conversations.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales and/or sales engineering experience, including at least 2 years in AI, search, or knowledge management solutions
  • Demonstrated experience operating in an overlay or specialist sales motion, with a track record of influencing deals across matrixed organizations
  • Executive presence with a history of leading C-suite conversations and Executive Briefing Center sessions at enterprise accounts
  • Proven ability to build pipeline collaboratively with AEs and SEs across large, complex sales organizations
  • Located in New York with ability to support customers and teammates in Central and Eastern time zones

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will be central to Zoom Phone’s global porting operations, managing number porting processes across the EMEA region while supporting India’s native number workflows. You will work at the intersection of customer experience and technical precision, collaborating closely with carriers, internal teams, and customers to deliver seamless number transitions. Your expertise in LNP processes and carrier systems will translate directly into customer satisfaction and operational excellence, making a tangible impact on how Zoom Phone delivers for its customers globally.


About the Team

Our Zoom Phone Porting team sits within Customer Care and Technical Support, focused on delivering reliable number porting operations for customers across EMEA and beyond. We work cross-functionally with service engineering, carrier partners, account executives, and customer success managers to resolve complex porting challenges and continuously improve our processes. As the team grows globally, collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and a commitment to customer outcomes are at the core of how we operate.


Responsibilities

•Manage standard and complex number porting requests for the EMEA region, coordinating with customers, CSMs, and account executives to ensure accurate and timely port completions.

•Support India’s native number processes, including KYC/KYB documentation management, number allocation, and compliance with in-country requirements.

•Collaborate with Zoom Phone’s global carrier partners and cross-functional internal teams to execute number transfers and manage porting requests end to end.

•Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve number porting fallout and technical numbering issues across EMEA, partnering with service engineering and technical support to drive timely resolution.

•Serve as the escalation point of contact for customer and internal porting concerns, ensuring issues are addressed with urgency, clarity, and a focus on customer satisfaction.

•Support strategic initiatives to streamline and enhance porting processes, improving team efficiency and the overall customer experience.

•Train new Zoom Phone Porting Specialists and support internal teams in understanding porting processes and setting accurate customer expectations.

•Operate within UK business hours to ensure EMEA region coverage, with flexibility as team needs evolve.


What We’re Looking For

•6+ years of number porting experience in the UK or EMEA region, with deep knowledge of LNP processes, carrier systems, and compliance verification.

•Working knowledge of VoIP, unified communications platforms, and telephony systems.

•Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

•Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM or ticketing platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk, or ServiceNow.

•Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional, customer-focused approach to internal and external interactions.

•Ability to work cross-functionally with global teams and adapt to evolving business needs, including flexible working hours.

•Proven track record of delivering exceptional customer satisfaction in a technical support or porting operations environment.

This is a role for a well-rounded, technically credible SE who brings broad knowledge across the full UCaaS stack, not just a single product line.

This role is for a forward-thinking UCaaS generalist with a passion for technology, a customer-first mindset, and a genuine drive to deliver happiness through transformative AI solutions.

Supporting Upmarket West accounts, our Solutions Engineering team acts as the strategic and technical backbone for complex enterprise deal cycles. job.title: Product Growth Marketing Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

Zoom is hiring five dedicated PLG (Product-Led Growth) Marketing Leads to own organic growth for five of its highest-priority AI products — each role reporting directly into the CEO org.


This is an individual contributor role at the intersection of product marketing, organic growth, and AI-native content creation. You'll shape how users discover and adopt Zoom's productivity products—from product insight through content creation, distribution, and measurement. This is an organic-only role—there is no paid activation budget. All growth will be driven through content, SEO/AEO, social, and conversion optimization.


About the Team

The Zoom productivity team is building a new AI-native way to work—helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables. As the product grows, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We're a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.


Responsibilities — Focus: Acquisition & Sign-up

  • Develop deep working knowledge of Zoom's productivity products: who uses them, what problems they solve, how they compare to alternatives, and where their real advantages lie.
  • Translate product positioning and messaging for PLG audiences that starts with the user problem, not the feature list—translating product capabilities into clear, outcome-oriented value.
  • Own end-to-end content creation and publication—including demos, tutorials, comparisons, social posts, emails, and web copy—from concept through measurement.
  • Use AI tools across the full content workflow—research, scripting, demo creation, editing, and iteration—to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Own the acquisition and sign-up funnel: build a repeatable content and distribution engine to drive organic discovery, landing page conversion, and sign-up completion.
  • Optimize landing pages, signup flows, and run CRO experiments to improve conversion rates.
  • Execute SEO and AEO content to improve organic discoverability and drive qualified traffic.
  • Create and distribute platform-native content across X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and Instagram Reels—matching format and depth to each platform's audience while maintaining Zoom brand guidelines.
  • Track what's working using engagement, trial, subscription, and adoption signals—then use those findings to improve content and calls to action.
  • Partner with Online Marketing on email campaigns and in-product activation—ensuring messaging consistency and coordinated user journeys.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing teams to keep product stories accurate and moving at the pace of product development.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years PLG experience in product marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, or social content, with focus on digital products (SaaS, AI tools, productivity platforms, or creator products).
  • Strong product instincts: ability to identify the most important user problems, recognize genuine differentiators, and turn those into product stories that are simple, specific, and credible.
  • Practical fluency using AI tools for research, scripting, demo creation, video editing, and content iteration—demonstrated through shipped work, not just familiarity.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create and publish end-to-end work: product videos, screen-recorded demos, and social content for digital products.
  • Strong understanding of how audiences, content formats, and distribution differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn—with demonstrated depth on multiple platforms.
  • Track record of building from scratch: cold-starting a content channel, product launch, or distribution system and driving it forward through ambiguity (candidates who have built and grown their own content channels with measurable results are encouraged to apply).
  • Comfort with rapid experimentation and scrappy execution: a willingness to test unconventional approaches, learn from what doesn't work, and iterate quickly without needing perfect conditions or established playbooks.
  • Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred—though not required if the work demonstrates the right instincts and execution ability.


Location: We are open to remote candidates in the US, or hybrid at our San Jose or Seattle offices.

As Premier Support Manager, you will lead a team of Technical Account Managers at the forefront of Zoom’s most strategic enterprise relationships, directly shaping customer outcomes and the long-term success of our Premier Support portfolio. Day to day, you will develop your team, define performance goals, and serve as an executive escalation point for complex customer situations, working in close partnership with Customer Success, Service Engineering, and Sales. You will report to senior leadership within the Global Premier Support organisation. This is a hybrid position at our London office.


About the Team

The Premier Support team delivers high-touch technical account management for Zoom’s most strategic enterprise customers, helping them realise the full value of Zoom Workplace. The team works at the intersection of technical expertise and relationship management, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to resolve complex challenges and drive proactive outcomes. As a key pillar of Zoom’s customer experience strategy, the team plays a meaningful role in retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the Premier portfolio.

job.title: Technical Support Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

On Zoom's Tier 2 Technical Support team, you'll serve as a trusted technical resource for our most strategic Premier customers, resolving complex issues that directly shape their experience with our platform. This is not a high-volume call center environment: your day-to-day is a focused mix of email-based ticket work and direct customer conversations with our highest-tier accounts, requiring both strong technical depth and the kind of communication skills that build lasting trust. You'll work within a collaborative team that values curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine commitment to customer outcomes.


About the Team

The Technical Support Engineering team plays a central role in elevating the customer experience at Zoom. We build strong internal and external relationships, resolve complex technical issues, and serve as a dedicated resource for our Premier customers while actively collaborating across internal teams and staying nimble as our product suite continues to grow.


Responsibilities

  • Engage Premier customers with clear, empathetic communication, prioritizing urgent requests and ensuring consistent, timely follow-up across all open cases
  • Own and resolve inbound Tier 2 support cases across core Zoom technology domains, managing escalations from Tier 1 and coordinating with Tier 3 engineers when needed
  • Analyze meeting quality product and network level issues by reviewing backend logs and network statistics to identify root causes such as packet loss, high latency, and connectivity degradation
  • Drive individual performance by consistently meeting established support goals and case metrics
  • Maintain technical proficiency across Zoom products, features, troubleshooting tools, and evolving best practices
  • Develop and contribute to internal and external documentation and training materials
  • Participate in an annual on-call rotation, providing support coverage a few times per year as scheduled


What We're Looking For

  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with a demonstrated ability to build rapport with enterprise customers and remain composed under pressure
  • 5+ years of experience in a Technical Support role, preferably supporting enterprise or Premier-tier customers
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot network issues affecting real-time communications, including interpreting packet captures to identify packet loss and jitter, with a solid understanding of UDP/TCP transport behavior
  • Knowledge of firewall rule analysis, proxy servers, VPN, split tunneling, and other network routing intermediaries
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Extensive hands-on experience with enterprise video conferencing platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or Slack, including experience administering these solutions at an organizational level; prior Zoom administration experience is a plus
  • Must be located in the Eastern Standard Time (EST) zone and available to work core hours of 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

You are the anchor of long-term technical success for some of Zoom's most complex enterprise contact center deployments. You own the ongoing technical relationship across a portfolio of MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, driving continuous optimization, resolving escalations, and ensuring customers extract measurable value from the platform. You work at the intersection of customer advocacy, platform expertise, and operational excellence, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to move quickly on what matters most. Candidates without hands-on cloud contact center experience or conversational AI platform expertise will not be considered for this role.


About the Team

Zoom’s Managed Services Operations (MSO) team is the long-term success engine for Zoom’s enterprise and premier contact center customers. We stay engaged after implementation, ensuring complex Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent environments remain optimized, resilient, and aligned to each customer’s evolving business goals. Our team operates at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success, and our work directly shapes how enterprise organizations experience and grow with Zoom’s contact center platform.


Responsibilities

  • Own the ongoing technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, serving as the primary technical advisor across configuration, optimization, and escalation management.
  • Lead recurring cadence calls, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and ad-hoc technical sessions with customer stakeholders, translating business objectives into actionable Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent strategies.
  • Execute day-two configurations including flow updates, queue management, skill-based routing, IVR modifications, and Zoom Virtual Agent conversation design changes across voice, chat, video, and SMS engagement channels.
  • Design and refine Zoom Virtual Agent bots, including intent training, NLP tuning, API and webhook integrations with platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow, and OAuth-based authentication flows.
  • Analyze call analytics dashboards and CX metrics to identify trends, surface quality issues, and recommend data-driven improvements aligned to each customer’s business outcomes.
  • Manage Tier 2/3 escalation triage for assigned accounts, coordinating with Zoom Support, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve critical incidents with defined timelines and thorough root-cause documentation.
  • Advocate internally for customer needs, driving feature requests, escalating product gaps, and maintaining awareness of platform releases and known issues that may affect customer environments.
  • Maintain detailed account documentation including meeting notes, configuration records, escalation logs, and runbooks, and contribute to team knowledge bases, playbooks, and AI-assisted automation tooling.
  • Partner with TAMs, CSMs, and Account Executives to deliver a unified customer experience, and actively participate in MSO Ops Weekly, team standups, and cross-functional syncs.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud contact center platforms, with Zoom Contact Center strongly preferred; equivalent experience with Genesys, NICE, or Five9 accepted.
  • Demonstrated experience with conversational AI and virtual agent platforms, including bot design, intent management, NLP configuration, and API integrations.
  • Strong command of contact center fundamentals: ACD, IVR/IVA, skill-based routing, workforce management concepts, and omnichannel engagement.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, JavaScript, and CRM/ITSM integrations including Salesforce and ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in call analytics interpretation and CX dashboard analysis, with the ability to translate data into clear, customer-facing recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences, with the ability to operate independently in a remote, distributed environment across time zones.
  • Experience in a managed services, professional services, or TAM/CSM capacity with ongoing account ownership responsibility; scripting and automation skills (Python, JavaScript) and certifications in Zoom, CCNA Collaboration, or cloud contact center platforms are a plus.

job.title: Lead Technical SEO Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences.


About the Team


You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.


Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.
  • Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture.
  • Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention.
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times.
  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering.
  • Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements.
  • Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs.
  • Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance.
  • Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change.
  • Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders.

What you can expect

You’ll lead discovery efforts to uncover meaningful opportunities, validate assumptions, and ensure we deliver impactful solutions. You’ll bring AI-first thinking to our product strategy, shaping how we apply emerging technologies to elevate employee experience.


As part of Workvivo (a Zoom company), you’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across design, engineering, and go-to-market teams, ensuring our product vision is informed by real-world insights and industry trends.

About the Team

Workvivo is an employee experience platform designed to amplify workplace culture and foster engagement. As part of Zoom, we’re aligned with a mission to help people connect, collaborate, and thrive—transforming how businesses innovate and employees interact.


  • Responsibilities
  • Lead product discovery and problem definition, ensuring we focus on the most valuable opportunities for our customers and business.
  • Conduct market research, user interviews, and data analysis to uncover needs and shape hypotheses.
  • Integrate AI-first thinking into product strategy and design, identifying opportunities to leverage AI to enhance user experience.
  • Partner with engineering and design to co-create solutions that are intuitive, scalable, and aligned with our product vision.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to capture feedback and ensure alignment on strategy and messaging.
  • Stay ahead of industry and technology trends, especially in AI and employee engagement platforms.
  • Define success metrics and ensure we learn and adapt through experimentation and iteration.

job.title: Technical Consultant
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What You Can Expect


You are the anchor of long-term technical success for some of Zoom's most complex enterprise contact center deployments. You own the ongoing technical relationship across a portfolio of MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, driving continuous optimization, resolving escalations, and ensuring customers extract measurable value from the platform. You work at the intersection of customer advocacy, platform expertise, and operational excellence, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to move quickly on what matters most. Candidates without hands-on cloud contact center experience or conversational AI platform expertise will not be considered for this role.

About the Team


Zoom’s Managed Services Operations (MSO) team is the long-term success engine for Zoom’s enterprise and premier contact center customers. We stay engaged after implementation, ensuring complex Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent environments remain optimized, resilient, and aligned to each customer’s evolving business goals. Our team operates at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success, and our work directly shapes how enterprise organizations experience and grow with Zoom’s contact center platform.


Responsibilities

  • Own the ongoing technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, serving as the primary technical advisor across configuration, optimization, and escalation management.
  • Lead recurring cadence calls, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and ad-hoc technical sessions with customer stakeholders, translating business objectives into actionable Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent strategies.
  • Execute day-two configurations including flow updates, queue management, skill-based routing, IVR modifications, and Zoom Virtual Agent conversation design changes across voice, chat, video, and SMS engagement channels.
  • Design and refine Zoom Virtual Agent bots, including intent training, NLP tuning, API and webhook integrations with platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow, and OAuth-based authentication flows.
  • Analyze call analytics dashboards and CX metrics to identify trends, surface quality issues, and recommend data-driven improvements aligned to each customer’s business outcomes.
  • Manage Tier 2/3 escalation triage for assigned accounts, coordinating with Zoom Support, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve critical incidents with defined timelines and thorough root-cause documentation.
  • Advocate internally for customer needs, driving feature requests, escalating product gaps, and maintaining awareness of platform releases and known issues that may affect customer environments.
  • Maintain detailed account documentation including meeting notes, configuration records, escalation logs, and runbooks, and contribute to team knowledge bases, playbooks, and AI-assisted automation tooling.
  • Partner with TAMs, CSMs, and Account Executives to deliver a unified customer experience, and actively participate in MSO Ops Weekly, team standups, and cross-functional syncs.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud contact center platforms, with Zoom Contact Center strongly preferred; equivalent experience with Genesys, NICE, or Five9 accepted.
  • Demonstrated experience with conversational AI and virtual agent platforms, including bot design, intent management, NLP configuration, and API integrations.
  • Strong command of contact center fundamentals: ACD, IVR/IVA, skill-based routing, workforce management concepts, and omnichannel engagement.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, JavaScript, and CRM/ITSM integrations including Salesforce and ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in call analytics interpretation and CX dashboard analysis, with the ability to translate data into clear, customer-facing recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences, with the ability to operate independently in a remote, distributed environment across time zones.
  • Experience in a managed services, professional services, or TAM/CSM capacity with ongoing account ownership responsibility; scripting and automation skills (Python, JavaScript) and certifications in Zoom, CCNA Collaboration, or cloud contact center platforms are a plus.

job.title: Sr Associate Implementation Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you are the primary driver of customer time-to-value, guiding a high-volume book of growth and commercial customers through structured onboarding from kickoff to launch. Each day, you'll lead configuration workshops, facilitate architecture discovery, and connect technical setup to each customer's real sales and marketing workflows. Your work directly shapes how quickly customers see results and how confidently they operate independently after go-live. You'll also serve as a key internal voice, surfacing patterns across implementations to strengthen the playbooks the whole team relies on. Candidates without hands-on CRM implementation experience (Salesforce and/or HubSpot) will not be considered for this role.


About the Team

Our Implementation team sits at the intersection of customer success, technical delivery, and product insight, making sure every new customer reaches value on time and with confidence. We operate with a playbook-driven approach that balances consistency with the flexibility needed to meet each customer's unique GTM environment. Our work directly supports Zoom's growth by turning new customers into informed, self-sufficient users who advocate for the platform.


Responsibilities

  • Lead 15 or more concurrent implementations for growth and commercial customers, guiding each through programmatic onboarding frameworks from kickoff through launch
  • Conduct architecture discovery sessions to map CRM structures, data sources, and GTM tooling, ensuring configuration aligns precisely with each customer's sales and marketing workflows

  • Hands-on knowledge of CRM infrastructure including Salesforce and/or HubSpot, covering custom objects, field mapping, reporting dependencies, and lead or contact routing logic
  • Familiarity with the B2B GTM ecosystem and how implementation platforms complement sales engagement tools, marketing automation, conversational intelligence, and data warehouses in a modern revenue stack

From day one, you'll follow a structured onboarding and ramp plan with dedicated coaching, certification, and continuous development.

This is a hybrid role based in Boston, with three days per week in the office



About The Team


Workvivo is a digital platform designed to enhance workplace culture, ensuring employees feel valued, included, and connected regardless of their location.


Dedicated to improving workplace experiences and achieving impactful results, it supports organizations worldwide. Spanning industries like automotive, technology, manufacturing, logistics, and finance, Workvivo transforms employee engagement across diverse sectors.

job.title: Global Program Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Global Program Manager on the Premier Support and Technical Account Management team, you will serve as the primary strategic partner for a select portfolio of enterprise customers, guiding them through every phase of their Zoom journey from implementation through long-term success. You will work at the intersection of customer relationships, technical complexity, and organizational coordination, bringing clarity and momentum to initiatives that span multiple teams and time zones. This role calls for someone who can operate confidently at the executive level while staying grounded in the details that drive delivery. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Zoom and within your customers' organizations to ensure consistent, measurable outcomes.


About the Team

The Premier Support and Technical Account Management team is dedicated to deepening customer relationships and elevating the Zoom experience for enterprise clients. We act as trusted technical advisors, providing resources, guidance, and cross-functional coordination that help customers realize the full value of our solutions. Our team operates across global markets, thrives on collaboration, and takes pride in turning complex challenges into clear paths forward.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise customers and internal stakeholders, proactively defining project scope, coordination, and objectives across both organizations.
  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, negotiate timelines and scope with stakeholders, and prioritize business expectations to deliver against agreed milestones.
  • Deliver consistent executive-level updates to key stakeholders at Zoom and within customer organizations, covering strategy, progress, and course corrections.
  • Apply industry best practices, methodologies, and standards across all project management and execution activities, including change management processes.
  • Monitor customer health and project performance, proactively addressing delivery risks and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Break complex, large-scale programs into phased workstreams with clearly defined tasks, owners, and timelines.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, Service Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Operations, and Global Architects to maintain consistency in customer support and engagement.
  • Capture and communicate customer feedback to relevant internal teams, and develop metrics frameworks that measure success and drive improvements to Zoom products and operational processes.
  • Adapt working style and schedule to support customers across diverse time zones, cultures, and regional requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of project management experience in global, enterprise-level environments, with a track record of managing complex programs to successful completion.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and communicate effectively with executive stakeholders, translating complex technical and project details into clear, strategic narratives.
  • Technical fluency in IP Telephony (SIP, H.323), Audio/Video codecs, UCaaS, video conferencing, and Unified Communications platforms such as Cisco, Microsoft Teams, and Polycom is highly desired.
  • Working knowledge of API/SDK concepts and their practical application in enterprise technology environments.
  • Project management certification required: PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience collaborating with global teams across diverse cultures and regions; strong written and oral English communication skills required, with additional languages a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.

job.title: Head of Sales Operations
job.description:
What you can expect

You will design the strategy and systems powering Zoom's go-to-market execution. You will partner cross-functionally to build a data-driven operating model. You will transform how Zoom forecasts and grows.

About the Team
Our team powers the planning, analytics, and systems behind Zoom's revenue engine. We partner cross-functionally turning strategy into execution. We make growth predictable and scalable.

Responsibilities

  • Leading end-to-end revenue planning — including annual planning, segmentation, territory design, capacity modeling, quota setting, and investment allocation — to translate company strategy into an executable go-to-market plan.

  • Owning the forecasting operating model and pipeline analytics infrastructure, building disciplined processes that give leadership clear visibility into performance, risk, and opportunity.

  • Driving Customer Success Operations including renewal models, churn analysis, account health scoring, adoption metrics, and expansion analytics to connect new business, retention, and customer value realization.

  • Partnering with Sales, Finance, HR, Marketing, and Data & Automation teams to operationalize compensation plans, pipeline generation, funnel conversion, and AI-driven productivity improvements across the revenue organization.

What we’re looking for

Essential:

  • Demonstrate significant experience leading Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.

  • Apply deep expertise in revenue planning, coverage models, territory design, capacity planning, and quota setting to build scalable go-to-market frameworks.

  • Build and manage forecasting models, pipeline analytics, deal inspection processes, and executive-level revenue visibility.

  • Design and improve sales processes, CRM governance, operating rhythms, and rules of engagement across a complex revenue organization.

  • Develop and operationalize sales compensation plans, incentive structures, commission rules, and performance tracking aligned to company strategy.

  • Lead or partner closely with Customer Success Operations on renewals, adoption, churn analysis, account health, and risk scoring.

  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership, driving cross-functional alignment in a matrixed organization.

Preferred:

  • Bring working knowledge of marketing funnel dynamics, lead management, pipeline generation, campaign attribution, and how AI and automation can improve revenue execution and seller productivity.

job.title: Zoom Phone Sales Specialist
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will work at the intersection of consultative selling and cloud communications, helping UK&I organisations move beyond legacy telephony to an intelligent, AI-first experience with Zoom Phone. You will partner closely with Account Executives and channel partners to drive net-new and upsell opportunities across the Mid-Market and Enterprise segments, supporting the full sales cycle from discovery through to close. This is a high-impact specialist sales position where your deep UCaaS expertise shapes how customers understand and adopt the future of business communications. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our London, UK office.

About the Team

The Zoom Phone sales team sits at the heart of Zoom Workplace, helping organisations replace legacy telephony with a cloud-native, AI-first communications platform. We work alongside Account Executives and channel partners with a consultative, customer-centric approach, showing businesses how voice, meetings, chat, and AI come together in a single solution. Our mission is to grow Zoom’s presence across UK&I by demonstrating that modern telephony is about unlocking the intelligence within every conversation.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives and channel partners to identify, develop, and close net-new and upsell Zoom Phone opportunities across Mid-Market and Enterprise segments
  • Deliver customer-specific Zoom Phone and AI-driven services demos tailored to each prospect’s business needs
  • Design and execute product and solution training programmes for Sales Engineers and channel partners
  • Drive pipeline hygiene by accurately tracking bookings, opportunities, and forecasts against quota in Salesforce CRM
  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of Zoom’s product differentiators, competitive landscape, and UCaaS sales methodologies
  • Serve as an escalation point for strategic opportunities, providing senior-level expertise to accelerate deals
  • Collaborate with internal product teams to surface customer feedback and influence product direction
  • Identify new ways to develop Zoom’s UCaaS go-to-market strategy across the UK&I region

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in a Direct Sales or Sales Overlay role within the UCaaS, Cloud PBX, or telephony space (e.g. CUCM, Avaya, Microsoft), covering Mid-Market and Enterprise segments
  • Proven track record of direct Cloud PBX/UCaaS product sales with consistent attainment against quota
  • Established channel partner relationships and an industry network that drives opportunity and engagement in the UK&I market
  • Demonstrated ability to lead executive-level conversations with C-Suite and VP-level stakeholders, addressing complex business needs
  • Strong financial selling acumen, including ROI and TCO analysis for UCaaS and AI-driven solutions
  • Experience managing a multi-channel pipeline and forecast with rigour, using Salesforce CRM or equivalent

job.title: Business Development Representative - Common Room
job.description:
What You Can Expect


We are building pipeline at scale in a market that's rapidly maturing. As a Commercial BDR, you will identify buyers, test strategies, and drive revenue growth.


This role requires proactive engagement, continuous improvement, and ownership of activities. You will directly shape our market approach within the Commercial segment.



About the Team


Common Room is an AI platform that consolidates buyer signals into one view, enabling teams to identify targets, craft messages, and determine timing effectively.


Supported by over $50M in funding from investors like Greylock, Index, and Madrona, Common Room is now part of Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA).



Responsibilities


  • Driving outbound pipeline generation across a high-volume account portfolio through focused prospecting using email, phone, and LinkedIn.
  • Conducting in-depth research and formulating a clear hypothesis outlining how Common Room resolves a particular business issue for the prospect.
  • Testing messaging, analyzing effectiveness, and applying insights across prospect lists ensuring consistent improvement in conversion rates.
  • Managing a dynamic pipeline with effective time prioritization—organizing tasks across a diverse account base and advancing leads through the funnel efficiently.
  • Partnering closely with Commercial Account Executives, aligning messaging, coordinating outreach, and ensuring seamless, well-qualified handoffs.
  • Utilizing sales engagement and CRM tools to maintain precise records, execute organized sequences, and monitor performance effectively.



What We're Looking For


  • Demonstrate strength in BDR tasks with proficiency in outbound fundamentals, including prospecting, addressing objections, and successfully scheduling meetings.
  • Operate effectively in a dynamic setting while maintaining consistent quality and adhering to standards, even when managing high levels of activity.
  • Understand how to research an account deeply and craft a relevant, insight-driven message tailored to their specific business context.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with sales engagement platforms such as Outreach or Salesloft and CRM tools like Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Treat data and performance metrics as inputs to improve — you track what's working and adjust quickly.
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment where you own your results and don't wait to be told what to do next.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
What You Can Expect


You will be one of the first voices a potential customer hears from Zoom — which means you're not just filling a pipeline, you're shaping someone's first impression of us.


Day-to-day, that looks like researching accounts, reaching out to the right people, and having real conversations about how Zoom can actually help their business. You'll work closely with Account Executives who've been in your shoes and want to see you win.


You won't just be grinding through a high-volume call list. We want someone who’s genuinely curious about customers, gets a little competitive about hitting goals, and cares about doing thoughtful work.



About the Team


Our Business Development team is the heartbeat of Zoom’s growth engine. We’re a group of creative problem-solvers who believe in authentic outreach, teamwork, and continuous improvement. Every conversation is a chance to make an impact on our customers and on your career.


You’ll be surrounded by people who celebrate wins together, learn from each call, and support one another in reaching both personal and team goals.



Responsibilities


  • Partner with Account Executives to identify and prioritize accounts that align with our business objectives.
  • Conduct proactive outreach through calls, emails, social engagement, and personalized video messages.

job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What You Can Expect


As a Technical Account Engineer on the Elite customer team, you serve as the primary technical expert and escalation point for Zoom's most complex voice, video, and unified communications challenges. Day to day, you partner with engineering, Client Services, Technical Account Management, and Sales to diagnose issues from first report through resolution, using advanced tools including log analysis, packet captures, and SIP traces. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth and customer impact, offering a genuine opportunity to build expertise across Zoom's UC and CC ecosystem while keeping some of the company's most critical customers running.


About the Team


The Elite customer support team owns technical issues end-to-end for Zoom's most strategically important accounts, covering the full spectrum of UC and CC challenges. We collaborate closely with engineering and services teams to deliver fast, thorough resolutions and prevent recurrence. Our mission is straightforward: keep Zoom's most critical customers running and make sure they always have a capable, committed expert in their corner.


Responsibilities


  • Own end-to-end technical support for assigned Elite customers, from issue diagnosis through resolution and ticket closure.
  • Troubleshoot complex voice, video, and UC issues using log analysis, packet captures, SIP traces, and Zoom proprietary tools.
  • Collaborate with engineering, Client Services, Technical Account Management, and Sales to resolve escalated issues and restore service.
  • Represent assigned customers in high-priority war rooms, coordinating cross-functional solutions under pressure.
  • Build and maintain deep knowledge of Zoom's products, integrations, and the broader UC/CC landscape to guide customers effectively.

What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of customer-facing technical support experience, functioning at a Tier 3, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep expertise in VoIP protocols (SIP, H.323), IP Phones, SBC, PBX, call routing, and SIP trunking.
  • Advanced voice and video quality troubleshooting skills, including the ability to read and analyze packet captures and SIP traces.
  • Familiarity with IVR workflows, omnichannel solutions, and UC/CC environments.
  • Strong general networking knowledge, supported by certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Wireshark, AWS, Azure, ITIL, or Microsoft Certified (or equivalent credential).
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation for customers, including RFCs and product guides.

job.title: Principal, Global PX Operations Lead
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Global People Experience Operations Lead, you serve as the operational engine behind Zoom’s People function and the right hand to the Global Head of PX Operations. You will turn strategy into shipped process, working systems, and metrics that hold up in front of executives, with genuine ownership over platform design, service architecture, and automation delivery. Your work centers on rebuilding Zoom’s ServiceNow HR Service Delivery platform, architecting a Tier 0 through Tier 3 service model, and embedding AI and automation into people processes that reach every Zoomie worldwide. Impact here is measured in concrete outputs: SLA compression, deflection rate, first-contact resolution, hours returned to the business, and ROI on every solution you ship.


About the Team

PX Operations is the shared services and operational backbone of Zoom’s People function, delivering across a matrixed, multi-region model spanning India, the Philippines, Mexico, and other global markets. The team supports Zoom’s overall business strategy by helping identify, hire, onboard, develop, and reward Zoomies while continuously improving the employee experience. Working here means partnering across a global community of coordinators, specialists, and CoE stakeholders to build a People function that scales with the business.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end ServiceNow HR Service Delivery platform rebuild, covering catalog architecture, case taxonomy, routing logic, knowledge management, approval workflows, and integrations with Workday and adjacent systems.
  • Architect and operationalize a Tier 0 through Tier 3 service model, building self-service capabilities, operating standards, escalation protocols, and governance frameworks across the global PX Ops community.
  • Design, deploy, and measure AI-powered and automated workflows across employee support, onboarding, offboarding, and talent acquisition operations, applying systems thinking to eliminate waste and compress cycle times.
  • Define and own the PX Operations reporting layer, including metrics frameworks, executive dashboards, and cadenced reporting on SLA compliance, deflection rates, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and ROI.
  • Drive global process harmonization across regional teams, establishing governance for AI and automation deployment that includes model validation, bias safeguards, audit trails, and compliance documentation.
  • Partner with CoEs, Payroll, Legal, IT, and Engineering on cross-functional escalations and platform integrations, representing PX Operations at senior stakeholder forums and serving as deputy to the Global Head of PX Operations.
  • Coach and enable the global PX Ops coordinator community on process discipline, tooling, and data literacy, raising capability across the offshore and onshore delivery model.


What We’re Looking For

  • 8 to 10 or more years of experience in HR/People Operations, shared services, HR technology, or transformation, with demonstrable ownership of operational delivery at enterprise scale within a multi-tier, multi-region organization.
  • Deep, hands-on ServiceNow expertise (HRSD strongly preferred), including at least one end-to-end platform rebuild or major redesign you led or co-led, plus strong Workday proficiency and experience with HRIS-to-case-management integration.
  • Proven track record designing and operating Tier 0 through Tier 3 service models, with documented results across SLA attainment, first-contact resolution, deflection rate, and CSAT.
  • Demonstrated AI and automation delivery experience with quantified outcomes, such as hours saved, volume deflected, cycle time reduced, or cost avoided.
  • Advanced data analysis skills and the ability to build and present executive-ready dashboards and stakeholder reporting, with fluency in translating analysis into clear recommendations.
  • Process improvement expertise through systems thinking methodologies such as Value Stream Mapping, root cause analysis, and Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or above preferred), combined with experience driving global process harmonization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent business experience, and the ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion across multiple regulatory environments.

job.title: Product Growth Lead, AI Productivity
job.description:
What You Can Expect


This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of product marketing, organic growth, and AI-native content creation. You will shape how small and medium-sized businesses, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams discover and understand the Zoom AI Productivity Suite. You will personally take ideas from product insight through scripting, recording, editing, publishing, and measurement. This is an opportunity to build a content and distribution system from the ground up and see how your work contributes directly to product growth.


About the Team


The Zoom AI Productivity Suite team is building a new AI-native way to work, helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables they can act on. As the product grows, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We are a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.


Responsibilities

  • Develop deep, working knowledge of the Zoom AI Productivity Suite, including who uses it, what problems it solves for small and medium-sized businesses and independent creators, how it compares to alternatives, and where its real advantages lie
  • Define and maintain positioning and messaging that starts with the user problem, not the feature list, and translates product capabilities into clear, specific, outcome-oriented value
  • Own the end-to-end creation and publication of product content, including short-form demos, screen recordings, tutorials, comparisons, social posts, emails, and web copy, from initial concept through measurement, without depending on an agency or production team
  • Use AI tools fluently across the full content workflow, including research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, editing, and rapid iteration, to move quickly without sacrificing quality
  • Build a repeatable content and distribution engine from the ground up to drive PLG strategy and take ownership of business growth targets, making independent prioritization calls and driving execution without waiting for a fully developed brief or established process
  • Plan and distribute platform-native content across X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and Instagram Reels, matching format and depth to the expectations of each audience and the stage of the funnel
  • Identify and engage with third-party platforms, software-review sites, benchmark leaderboards, and vertical communities to build product credibility, drive discovery, run user operations and generate trial
  • Track what is working using engagement quality, trial, subscription, and adoption signals, then use those findings to improve product stories, content formats, and calls to action
  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing partners to keep product stories accurate and move content at the pace of product development


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, social content, with a focus on digital products such as SaaS, AI tools, productivity platforms, or creator products, or equivalent experience
  • Strong product instincts: the ability to identify the most important user problems, recognize genuine product differentiators, and turn those insights into product stories that are simple, specific, and credible, particularly for small and medium-sized business audiences, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams
  • Hands-on fluency using AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, video editing, and content iteration, not just familiarity with the tools but practical comfort shipping work with them
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create and publish work end-to-end, including short-form product videos, screen-recorded demos, and social content created to market and explain digital products
  • Strong understanding of how audiences, content formats, and distribution dynamics differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn, with demonstrated depth on at least some of these platforms
  • A track record of building from scratch: cold-starting a content channel, a product launch, or a distribution system, and driving it forward through ambiguity without waiting for established processes. Candidates who have built and grown their own relevant content channels with measurable results are also encouraged to apply
  • Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred, though not required if the work itself demonstrates the right instincts and execution ability

job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Technical Account Manager at Zoom, reporting into a Premier Support Manager, you’ll be the trusted technical voice that enterprise customers rely on - driving their success while helping shape how Zoom grows alongside them. This role is built for someone who thrives on mastering complex challenges across unified communications, CCaaS, and enterprise networking, and who brings at least 5 years of direct, hands-on customer-facing technical experience. Candidates without enterprise customer-facing technical experience are unlikely to be competitive for this position.


About the Team

The Premier Support and Technical Account Management team plays a crucial role in improving the customer experience within Zoom. We build relationships, encourage product usage, and act as dedicated technical consultants for customers. We provide our customers with valuable resources that enable them to succeed with our solutions, and we effectively manage internal procedures and collaborate across departments.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as a technical subject-matter expert on Zoom’s architecture and video/audio collaboration space.
  • Own complex technical escalations as the primary point of contact, driving them toward timely resolution while partnering with the account team to strengthen the customer relationship.
  • Provide technical consultations for architecture integration and service optimization.
  • Manage technical feature requests and requirements that are key to the customer’s success and process workflow.
  • Develop a trusted technical advisor relationship with customers and provide recommendations based on the Zoom product suite to address their business needs.
  • Partner with Customer Success Manager to notify customers about product enhancements and incremental product releases.
  • Be the Voice of the Customer internally within Zoom to drive prioritization of business needs for our customers, working with the assigned Customer Success Manager.

  • Hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will also be considered.

  • Have an understanding of IP Telephony, SIP/H.323, VoIP, audio/video codecs, and telecom infrastructure, including PBX, carriers, and networking protocols (UDP/TCP/IP).

job.title: Technical Account Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you serve as the primary technical point of contact for Zoom's most strategic enterprise customers, owning integration challenges from first report to final resolution across Zoom's full suite of Video, Native, Mobile, and CoBrowse SDKs. Day to day, you partner with SDK engineering, Solutions Engineers, and CSMs to diagnose multi-layer technical problems, lead customer troubleshooting calls, and translate complex issues into documented solutions that millions of developers depend on. Candidates without hands-on experience reading and debugging code across JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python, or without direct API/SDK integration or troubleshooting experience, will find the core technical demands of this role difficult to meet. This is a strong opportunity for a technically grounded customer advocate ready to solve hard problems and make a measurable difference at scale. This role reports to a Manager, Technical Account Engineer.


About the Team

The API & SDK team serves as the embedded technical experts for Zoom's most demanding enterprise accounts, covering the full lifecycle of SDK and API integration challenges across Video, Native, Mobile, and CoBrowse SDKs. We collaborate closely with iOS, Web, and CoBrowse engineering alongside TAMs, CSMs, and Solutions Engineers to ensure end-to-end issue ownership and resolution. Our mission is to keep Zoom's most strategic customers running and make their developers' lives easier.


Responsibilities

•Own end-to-end technical support for enterprise customers integrating Zoom's Video SDK (Web, iOS, Android), Meeting SDK, Native SDK, Mobile SDK, and CoBrowse SDK into their products.

•Debug across the full stack, including client-side JavaScript/TypeScript, native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) and Android (Kotlin/Java), Python backend services, and REST/WebSocket APIs.

•Reproduce, isolate, and document customer-reported bugs using session logs, HAR traces, and SDK diagnostics, then drive resolution in close partnership with engineering.

•Lead technical troubleshooting calls with customer engineering teams to diagnose issues, provide workarounds, and coordinate fixes with Zoom SDK engineering.

•Translate customer pain into engineering action by filing detailed bug reports, advocating for feature requests, and ensuring fixes land in the right SDK release.
